# Personas Core — pattern fabric

This workspace maintains 284 adopted engineering patterns that apply to this repo. They are conventions to follow here unless this repo has a documented reason to differ — if you find such a reason, say so rather than silently diverging.

## Before non-trivial development work: consult

1. Name the situation you are about to work on ("add a table", "new IPC command", …).
2. Match it against the **playbooks** below (triggers listed per playbook; machine index in `.claude/patterns/index.json`).
3. Read the matched brief in `.claude/patterns/playbooks/<slug>.md` — apply its *before* items first, its *during* items while building, and do not call the work done until its *verify* items hold.
4. Cite the pattern ids you applied (or deviated from, and why) in your commit/PR description.
5. If the Personas app is running, `GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dev-tools/patterns/consult?intent=<your situation>&project_id=<id>` returns the same brief with this repo's live adherence per pattern.

_No playbooks are active yet — the library is browsable in `.claude/patterns/library.md`._
